summary: Wave 11.1 — OAuth GitHub/Facebook coming_soon + Invitations + ShareButton + SEO/sitemap. Backend: 11/11 new tests pass + 58/58 regression pass (test_wave6_auth_email + test_wave7_growth + test_wave8a_ecosystem + test_discovery + test_sources_center + test_growth). Frontend: login via /join → /correo works; invite block rendered on desktop with 8-char code (E2CBF77A), copy button writes correct URL to clipboard, share menu opens with all 6 sub-items (linkedin/facebook/twitter/whatsapp/telegram/copy) and window.open is invoked with the exact official deep-link URLs required by the spec (linkedin.com/sharing/share-offsite/, facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php, twitter.com/intent/tweet, api.whatsapp.com/send, t.me/share/url). Verified: (a) /api/community/auth/providers returns google enabled, and linkedin+microsoft+github+facebook+apple+twitter in coming_soon; (b) /api/community/auth/oauth/github/start and /oauth/facebook/start both return 503 with 'no configurado' message (CLIENT_ID missing in preview env); (c) GET /api/community/auth/me/invite returns {code(8-uppercase-alphanum), url(contains /join?invite=CODE), invited_registered, share_message}; (d) POST /register with valid invite_code increments referrer counter by 1; two distinct invitees ⇒ +2; (e) duplicate email registration returns 409 and does NOT double-increment; (f) unknown invite_code XXXXXXXX still allows registration to succeed 200 with counter unchanged; (g) GET /api/seo/sitemap.xml returns 200 application/xml with <urlset> root and >=15 <url> entries covering /empresas, /join, /noticias + individual company pages; (h) GET /api/seo/robots.txt returns 200 with Sitemap: line; (i) GET /api/seo/og/company/microsoft returns 200 HTML with og:title containing 'Microsoft', og:description, og:image, canonical link, JSON-LD schema.org Organization; nonexistent slug returns 404 fallback OK; (j) desktop UI region chip visible + no horizontal scroll at any breakpoint.

issues: ProfileCardWidget's parent column .pc-community-left has display:none on mobile+tablet, so workspace-invite-block, workspace-invite-code, workspace-invite-copy, share-button-invite are ALL hidden (not just off-screen — parent is display:none). The review request explicitly demands 'Invite block visible + share button clickable' at 360x780 and 768x1024. No horizontal scroll however (docScrollW == winW). Region chip is inside the same hidden column so it's also invisible on mobile/tablet.

action_items: Responsive: expose InviteBlock (+ region chip) on mobile/tablet. Currently .pc-community-left is display:none < ~lg. Consider hoisting InviteBlock into a location visible at all breakpoints, or unhide it in the mobile stack.

Optional: JoinPage social tab lists LinkedIn/Microsoft/Apple/Facebook/X 'PRONTO' but does NOT show GitHub — while backend correctly advertises github in coming_soon. If desired, add a github tile to keep the UI aligned with /api/community/auth/providers. Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: seo_routes.og_company correctly serves crawler-friendly HTML with meta refresh — matches the review's 'by design' note. Nice.

_credit_invite iterates users collection to match hashed code — O(N) but bounded and idempotent via upsert on invited_user_id. Fine for current scale; consider indexing invite_code once a user record materialises it.
ShareButton.jsx uses window.open (buttons, not <a href>) → safe & compliant, all 5 targets emit official deep-link URLs (verified via window.open spy).
Register endpoint swallows invite credit exceptions with logger.info — invites are best-effort, matches spec 'never blocks registration'.
Login test passes username via case-normalised email — good.
sitemap.xml uses PUBLIC_APP_URL from env; falls through to '' if unset (relative URLs). Not ideal for a real sitemap but preview env has PUBLIC_APP_URL set correctly.
og_company canonical uses PUBLIC_APP_URL first, then request.base_url — good graceful fallback.

success_rate.frontend: 90% — all invite/share features verified on desktop with official deep-link URLs & clipboard; responsive breakpoints hide the block on mobile/tablet

seed_data_creation: Registered ~4 short-lived test users via /api/community/auth/register with invite_code=E2CBF77A (Demo Miembro's code) to exercise the referrer counter. All prefixed test_wave111_* — can be cleaned up in a future run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wave 11.1 backend is fully green. Reusable tests: /app/backend/tests/test_wave11_1_growth.py (11 tests, ~21s). Frontend has one responsive design gap (invite block hidden < lg breakpoint) — not a functional regression, just doesn't match the spec's 'visible at all breakpoints' requirement. Correct testids on /join email form are join-input-email / join-input-password / join-email-submit (not join-email-input). Share URLs are opened via window.open — install a spy: `window.__openCalls=[]; window.open=(u,t)=>window.__openCalls.push({url:u,target:t});` before clicking share menu items.
